mapper.select: SELECT ts.track_id,ti.track_title,ti.media_duration,ti.order_num, MAX(IF(ts.stat_type='0701',stat_num,0)) playStatNum, MAX(IF(ts.stat_type='0704',stat_num,0)) commentStatNum, ti.create_time FROM track_stat ts INNER JOIN track_info ti on ts.track_id=ti.id where ti.album_id=#{albumId} and ti.is_deleted=0 and is_open='1' and status='0501' GROUP BY ti.id
